result:
The proposed solution does not derive its count. It says only that "systematic analysis" gives eight, without classifying which quasivarieties have the amalgamation property. As I recall the literature on amalgamation in quasivarieties of Sugihara algebras, the number is different from 8, probably 20. I could not verify that figure, so my rejection rests on the missing derivation and on this recollection.

VERDICT: REJECT
